entities.summary: Marina Elvira Berlusconi is an Italian businesswoman. She is the chairwoman of the holding company Fininvest and the publishing company Arnoldo Mondadori Editore, the latter being the biggest publishing company in Italy. She is the eldest daughter of businessman and former Italian prime minister Silvio Berlusconi.
